risk_flags.note: Scenario uses partial entity masking; actor names are fictionalized accordingly.
Corpus does not fully specify geographic scope or minimum breadth of availability beyond customer availability vs preorder.
Late-stage supply, regulatory, or manufacturing issues could swing outcome quickly within the September window.
Official schedule language may overstate certainty relative to actual customer-facing readiness.

simulation_brief.core_question: Will Phone A be available to customers by September 30, 2025?
simulation_brief.resolution_rule: Resolve yes only if Phone A is available to customers by 2025-09-30; preorder without general availability is insufficient.
simulation_brief.summary: A major smartphone manufacturer has announced Phone A, a new thin smartphone model, and says preorders will open soon with availability beginning later in September 2025. The central uncertainty is whether actual customer availability, not merely preorder access, occurs by September 30, 2025.
simulation_brief.title: phone_a_availability_by_2025_09_30
uncertainty_notes: Source packet indicates planned availability in the second half of September.
Short-horizon launch could slip due to supply, regulatory, or manufacturing issues.
Exact geography and definition of customer availability beyond preorder/general availability are not fully specified in the corpus.

sociology_prompt_influences.description: Official statement anchors expectations to second-half September availability.
